import React, { useState } from "react"; export default function CampusComplaintPage() { const [form, setForm] = useState({ name: "", rollNo: "", email: "", phoneNumber: "", subgroup: "", branch: "", complaintType: "", complaint: "", }); function onChange(e) { const { id, value } = e.target; setForm((prev) => ({ ...prev, [id]: value })); } function onSubmit(event) { event.preventDefault(); const newComplaint = { ...form, formType: "Campus Complaint", }; const complaints = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("complaints")) || []; complaints.push(newComplaint); localStorage.setItem("complaints", JSON.stringify(complaints)); setForm({ name: "", rollNo: "", email: "", phoneNumber: "", subgroup: "", branch: "", complaintType: "", complaint: "", }); alert("Complaint submitted successfully!"); } return ( <>
